topic: Which processes the session list shows as unpinned
detail: Unpinned rows are every claude, codex or gemini process of the user with no live pin, by kernel name as procstat.FindByName does (plus node/bun/deno and version-named binaries by program). On this Mac that includes Codex's app-server daemon processes and every claude subprocess that keeps the name, not only interactive sessions. Decide whether to filter (e.g. only processes with a TTY, or skip children of a harness).
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: skip harness children and known daemons; see D-48 and RC-59.
